strategy_summary: Two-stage Apéry-representative strategy: first classify numerical semigroups of multiplicity m by the tuple w_r of minimal elements in each nonzero residue class modulo m, prove the intrinsic inequalities and genus formula in these w-coordinates, then pass to Kunz coordinates x_r = (w_r - r)/m and translate the Apéry conditions into the stated Kunz inequalities and sum condition.
